description: edge-touching-fuse's boxes, the second turned as in edge-touching-tilted by one tolerance (1e-7) and cut from the first: the tool's edge crosses the box's at its middle, its upper half inside the box and its lower outside, the ends a tolerance off. Arris keeps the crossing as a vertex on the box's edge and cuts nothing else — the box, its volume exact; the section block along both edges at once is both faces' boundary, not an image of one edge on the other face (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey; step 9, the block along an edge of each face)

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE returns the box with its edge whole (8/12/6/6); Arris keeps the vertex where the tool's edge crosses it, its ends a tolerance off
